## [3.66.0] - 2026-08-20

### Features

- update date handling in Z report date range dialog to use AppClock
- add quick date presets to Z report date range dialog

### Bug Fixes

- preserve multipass swipe card codes
- preserve multipass swipe card codes
- coalesce PayTag reconciliation
- await loyalty data for PayTag checks
- harden gift card voucher restrictions
- gift-card/voucher cross-payment block matched product names, not real gift-card products
- preserve manual discount sync marker
- address refund discount review comments
- limit image cookies to Odoo origin
- refresh cached logo slots
- distinguish salesperson load errors
- discard pending payment state

### Other Changes

- Fix legacy loyalty refund note matching
- Fix stale test API usage
- Fix auth error name cast
- Fix cash rounding split payment settlement
- Fix scanned order online lookup
- validate odoo19 development pull requests
- Do not allocate unmarked voucher adjustments on refund
- Fix refund discount line classification
- Handle legacy refund net adjustments
- Windows SSL-fix button + safer session-error handling (404/500 no longer forces logout) (#307)
- Fix refund discount adjustment classification
- Use Dart customer display view on Android
- Preserve Nayax cancellation status code
- Fix Nexo terminal cancel handling
- Use branch salesperson sales report
